howto.what: 安装后，NanoClaw 会多一个 WhatsApp 入口：它能通过官方 Meta WhatsApp Cloud API 收发一对一私聊消息。这个技能会把适配器复制进项目、注册并构建验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp 时运行；通常用于 /setup 流程中，或后续用 /manage-channels 把该通道接给某个代理组时。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp Cloud 通道。
say.note: 技能会复制适配器并安装依赖。

say.text: 我要用 WhatsApp 官方 API 接入我的机器人。
say.note: 会注册 whatsapp-cloud 通道并构建验证。

say.text: 请设置 WhatsApp Cloud API 通道。
say.note: 需要你先在 Meta 后台准备访问令牌等信息。

howto.what_en: After install, NanoClaw gains a WhatsApp entry point: it can send/receive one-to-one messages via the official Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API. The skill copies the adapter into the project, registers it, and runs build/tests.
howto.when_en: Run when you want to add WhatsApp to NanoClaw, typically during the /setup flow, or later via /manage-channels to connect this channel to an agent group.

say_en.text: Add the WhatsApp Cloud channel to NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter and installs dependencies.

say_en.text: Connect my bot to WhatsApp using the official API.
say_en.note: Registers whatsapp-cloud and validates the build.

say_en.text: Set up the WhatsApp Cloud API channel.
